purpose: Make one Initial Snapshot, Reconciliation Snapshot, or Change Cycle's completion proof durable only after its entire local page chain is staged: build the byte-stable Snapshot Completion or Change Completion from the cycle's own page, fragment, and record counts and final chain, seal it, and append it to the Sender Outbox after every fragment, exactly once, or stage nothing.

inputs.name: completed_cycle
inputs.description: The record type and identity of one cycle the caller believes finished: a snapshot attempt's own cycle or one of its Change Cycles.

inputs.name: staging_context
inputs.description: The Sender's active Sender Installation, its installation key alias, and the capability generation to stage under, as stage-outbox-batch uses.

inputs.name: installation_cipher
inputs.description: The 3ug InstallationCipher seam, which seals the completion with AES-256-GCM under the installation key.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: the record type's current snapshot attempt, the cycle's page-chain progress, the Sender Outbox high-water mark, and this unit's completion records, read before sealing and again inside the commit transaction.

outputs.name: completion_staged
outputs.description: One sealed Snapshot Completion, with an explicit initial or reconciliation kind, or Change Completion, appended to the Sender Outbox under the next sequence after every fragment of its cycle, recorded as the cycle's only completion in the same transaction. It carries no source cursor or token.

outputs.name: refusal
outputs.description: A named reason the cycle cannot be completed now, such as an incomplete local chain or a completion already staged, with nothing written.

outputs.name: conflict
outputs.description: The cycle, its attempt, the completion record, or the Outbox sequence changed while the completion was being sealed, so nothing was written and the completion can be staged again.

outputs.name: cipher_failure
outputs.description: The installation key was missing, unusable, or unavailable, or the cipher failed unexpectedly, with nothing written.

outputs.name: storage_failure
outputs.description: A database read or the commit failed and rolled back, so nothing was staged.

observable_effects.name: installation-key-seal
observable_effects.description: Seals the completion once through the installation cipher with stage-outbox-batch's authenticated data for its installation and sequence; never creates, deletes, or opens with the key.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Applies this unit's Sender schema migration, and commits the sealed completion through stage-outbox-batch's Outbox primitive with this unit's completion record in one SQLite transaction or not at all.

owns: building the Snapshot Completion and Change Completion messages from a finished cycle's own progress
the rule that a cycle is completed at most once, only after its whole local chain is staged, and only while its snapshot attempt is current
the Sender's completion records and their schema migration
classification of cipher and storage failures into the named failures for a completion
does_not_own: the Sender Outbox, its sequence high-water mark, and its sealing format, which belong to stage-outbox-batch
page-chain progress and when a chain is finished, which belong to stage-outbox-batch
snapshot attempts and their currency, which belong to begin-initial-snapshot
deciding when to complete a cycle, or when the catch-up Change Cycle may begin after an acknowledged Snapshot Completion, which belong to coordinate-sender-sync
delivery and receipt-bound removal, which belong to send-outbox-message
the Wire Protocol message format, which belongs to ingest-protocol
the Expo bridge between Kotlin and TypeScript
